questions.prompt: Why did git allow the first switch but refuse the second?
options: README.md is the same on both branches, so the edit was not in the way; trails/lake.md differs, so switching would have overwritten the edit
Git allows one switch with uncommitted changes per session, then refuses
Edits to Markdown files in a folder are always blocked
The second switch was refused because winter has more commits than main

goals.label: Scenario 1: the README edit travels to winter
Scenario 2: git refuses to switch to main over the lake edit
Scenario 3: back on main after a safe fix, with no conflict left
